title: DAO timing constants (initial/retry/refresh) never wired into a runtime TX scheduler
description: Spec 09 14.2 R-09-017..019: initial DAO random 0-2s after joining; DAO retry 4/8/16s exponential backoff; DAO refresh 15 minutes (30-min soft state lifetime / 2). Classification: DIVERGENT (implemented+tested as library code, no runtime consumer) - all three languages define and unit-test the timing functions but NO node runtime drives them: Rust rust/lichen-rpl/src/dao_timing.rs (DAO_INITIAL_DELAY_MIN/MAX_MS:9-12, DAO_RETRY_DELAYS_MS=[4000,8000,16000]:15, DAO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_SECONDS=900:27, DaoRetryBackoff:196, DaoRefreshTimer:122; inline tests :259-467) is exported (lib.rs:24) but has no consumer in lichen-node/lichen-gateway; Python python/src/lichen/timing/dao.py:10-53 likewise not consumed by DaoManager (dao_manager.py); C lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_timing.c + lichen/tests/rpl_dao_timing/main.c likewise has no caller outside its test. Suggested placement: wire DaoRetryBackoff + DaoRefreshTimer into rust/lichen-node RplStack DAO TX path (after build_signed_dao / send_dao), mirror in python DaoManager and C rpl node loop; keep constants as the cross-language oracle.
